g.text: Both series use OpenAlex with the extended AI definition (subfield 1702 + subfield 1707, matching the snapshot's q1_v3_extended scheme modulo topic T10502, which contributes <2%). The neuroscience→AI rise reproduces at full magnitude in fresh vintage; the AI→neuro 2024–25 spike does not — it appears only in the March-2026 snapshot.
